verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments platform, since some payment gateways ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Adyen offers a self-hosted deployment of its processing platform. Local-network terminal communication and offline payments are adjacent features, not self-hosting the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
